page.layout: One page of text (right printed page, main column of entries); notes in the left margin belonging to the facing page, cut off at the gutter edge; running head at top centre; page number top right; signature "E 3" at foot.

main_text.p: fecit.praef.pass. γνωρίζωμαι innotesco, Philip. 4. 6. τὰ αἰτήματα ὑμῶν γνωρίζεσθω (3. sing. praef.pass.imper.) ὡσὰς τὸν Θεὸν, petitiones vestra innotescant apud Deum. pråt.pass. ἐγνώ- σθην. a.1.pass. ἐγνωρίσθην innotui. a.1.pass. subj. γνωρισθῶ ἡς ἡ.
Γνώμη ης ἡ, sententia, Act.20. v.3. Apoc.17. verf.13. consilium, 1.Cor.7. v.5. permissio, Philem.v.14.
Γνωστὸς ἡ ὃν notus a um, Act.15.8.

Γογγύζω murmuro. imperf. ἐγόγγυζον, Luc.5.30. ἐγόγγυζον αὐτῶν (pro καὶ' αὐτῶν) obmurmurabant eis. Simplex pro composito καταγογγύζω. praes. imperat. γόγγυζε, Johan.6.v.43. μὴ γογγύζετε ne murmurate. F.vow.P. γεγογγύκα. a.1. ἐγογγύσα.
Γόης ἡ ὁ impostor, proprie, incantator, praestigiator, a verbo γοάω gemo, 2.Tim.3.13.
Γόμος ὁ onus, navis, Act.21.3. merces, Apoc.18.11. a prat. med. γέγομα quod est a γέμω, vide supra.
Γονεὺς ὁ parens, a γονὴ ης ἡ generatio. quod est a prat.med. γέγονα, 2.Cor.12.14.
Γονυπετέω ὠ ad genua accido. Fut.ήσω. P. γεγονυπετημαι. aor.1. ἐγονυπέτησα. cum Dat.

page.notes: Left-margin notes are partly cut off at the gutter and largely illegible; not transcribed. Greek accents in the scan are doubtful in several places, marked by reading as printed as far as possible. Left-margin fragments such as "Jac.3.11", "Marc.9.3", "Heb.12.11", "Philip.1.21" belong to the facing page and are not included.
